# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the current `main` branch is supported. This is a personal homelab; there are no releases.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue.

Report privately via [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Mahagon/homelab/security/advisories/new).

Expect a response within 7 days. Please include steps to reproduce and the affected file or component.

## Scope

In scope: manifests, bootstrap scripts, Butane config and CI workflows in this repo (e.g. leaked secrets, insecure defaults, workflow injection).

Out of scope: vulnerabilities in upstream projects (K3s, ArgoCD, Jellyfin, etc.). Please report those upstream.
